description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetConfigVariable, which provides a method to retrieve configuration variables within the Smarty templating engine. It includes a method getConfigVariable that accesses a specific configuration variable via an internal data structure.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetConfigVariable
